title: Ultimate Custom Run
description:
Adjust Slay the Spire 2 custom runs with modifiers, starting options and presets.

[h2]Custom Run menu and presets[/h2]
Collapsible groups: Improved Start, Run Parameters, Modifiers, Card Pool, Ascension and Negatives. Exclusive choices are linked; Specialized, All Star and Friendship variants share a checkbox. Co-op-only options appear under Disabled in singleplayer.
Save the selected modifiers and slider values as a named loadout. Empty clears all selections. Delete local presets with the remove icon beside each dropdown item; your current selection is preserved.

[h2]Custom Run Parameters[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Floors per act:[/b] Vanilla or 8-30 total floors, including the Ancient/start and first boss. Applies in singleplayer and co-op; extra bosses, campfires and ??? add floors. New maps honor the value, including after loading; existing saved maps keep their layout.
[*][b]Base hand size:[/b] Vanilla or 0-10 cards. Changes normal start-of-turn draw; the engine hand limit stays 10.
[*][b]Base energy:[/b] Vanilla or 0-10 energy.
[*][b]Enemy HP, enemy damage and player HP:[/b] 25-500%, step 25%, default 100%. Player HP changes starting HP; Dill overrides that starting value.
[/list]
The hover tip lists changed settings with highlighted values. Parameters persist in saves and presets and synchronize from the co-op host.

[h2]Starting modifiers and variants[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Neow!!:[/b] Restore the usual starter relic choice after other starting effects.
[*][b]Headstart:[/b] Choose 1-5 distinct relics at Neow (default 1), using a searchable compendium-style picker and confirmation. Includes unlocked character-compatible Ancient, Event, Shop and eligible Starter relics under native Neow restrictions. Co-op players choose independently.
[*][b]???:[/b] Play 1-5 additional Events after Neow (default 3), each on an extra floor. Uses unlocked events without custom appearance conditions, without repeats; ends early if no unvisited eligible events remain. Supports saving and co-op. Main-map layout is unchanged.
[*][b]Ultimate Starter:[/b] Replace basic starter Strikes and Defends with 3 Ultimate Strikes and 3 Ultimate Defends. Preserve special starter cards such as Bash and Zap. Deck-replacement modifiers replace that deck afterward.
[*][b]Super Draft:[/b] Add card rewards to your starting deck until you pass. Each pick risks a Curse: 0.5%, doubling each offer. Above 100%, gain guaranteed Curses plus the remaining chance. Passing adds no Curse.
[*][b]Specialized - Normal:[/b] Start with 1-10 copies of one random eligible card (default 5).
[*][b]Specialized - Draft:[/b] Choose one Card Reward, then add the selected number of copies.
[*][b]Specialized - Pick Any:[/b] Choose an eligible common, uncommon or rare card from your character's pool, then add the selected number of copies.
[*][b]All Star - Normal:[/b] Start with 1-10 random Colorless cards (default 5).
[*][b]All Star - Draft:[/b] Choose the selected number of Colorless card rewards.
[*][b]Friendship - Normal:[/b] Start with 1-10 copies of a random Co-Op card (default 5). Co-op only.
[*][b]Friendship - Draft:[/b] Choose the selected number of Co-Op card rewards. Co-op only.
[*][b]Draft:[/b] Choose 5-20 card rewards to replace your starting deck (step 5, default 10).
[*][b]Sealed Deck:[/b] Choose cards from a fixed pool to replace your deck. Pool: 10-60 offers (default 30). Choose 5 to pool size minus 5 cards (default 10). Both step 5; shrinking the pool clamps the pick count. Card Swarm does not enlarge this pool.
[*][b]Insanity:[/b] Replace your deck with 5-60 random cards (step 5, default 30).
[/list]
Variants within a family are mutually exclusive. Draft, Sealed Deck and Insanity are mutually exclusive. Super Draft adds cards after deck replacement. Draft rewards may be skipped unless Must Have is enabled.

[h2]Map, rewards and card pools[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Double Trouble:[/b] Fight 2-3 different bosses per Act (default 2), with separate normal rewards, including the final Act. Double Boss/A10 does not add another boss.
[*][b]Campfires between bosses:[/b] Optional Double Trouble submodifier; adds a normal Rest Site between each pair of bosses. Off by default, inactive without its parent.
[*][b]Hoarder:[/b] Add 1-5 extra copies whenever a card enters your deck (default 2). Merchant card removal is disabled.
[*][b]Flight:[/b] Ignore paths when choosing the next room.
[*][b]Vintage:[/b] Normal enemies give relics instead of card rewards.
[*][b]Rich Loot:[/b] Treasure chests contain 1-3 extra relics to choose from (step 1, default 1); empty chests remain empty.
[*][b]Card Swarm:[/b] Card rewards contain 1-3 extra offers (step 1, default 1), including standard Draft and starting drafts. Fixed tutorial rewards remain unchanged.
[*][b]Colorless Cards:[/b] Add Colorless cards to rewards through the native Dingy Rug relic.
[*][b]Character card pools:[/b] Add Ironclad, Silent, Regent, Necrobinder or Defect cards to rewards and eligible Merchant offerings.
[/list]

[h2]Negative modifiers[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Must Have:[/b] Take a card from every card reward before leaving. Rerolls and non-card rewards remain optional. Passing during Super Draft is allowed.
[*][b]Speedrun:[/b] Lose 5 HP every full minute after a 10-60 minute limit (step 5, default 30). Uses the native run timer and singleplayer pause behavior; penalties persist in saves and the host schedules them in co-op.
[*][b]Dill:[/b] Start with 1-20 max HP (default 1); gain 1-5 max HP after each combat victory (default 2). Both step 1. Starts at full selected HP, overriding initial HP scaling. Uses native max-HP gain and healing; saved earned HP is preserved.
[*][b]Deadly Events:[/b] Unknown rooms can contain Elites and are more likely to contain Treasure.
[*][b]Cursed Run:[/b] Gain a random Curse at the start of each Act.
[*][b]Big Game Hunter:[/b] More Elites; Elite card rewards contain Rare cards.
[*][b]Midas:[/b] Enemies give 150-300% of normal gold (step 5%, default 200%). Smithing is disabled.
[*][b]Murderous:[/b] Players and enemies start combat with 3 Strength.
[*][b]Night Terrors:[/b] Resting heals all HP but costs 5 max HP.
[*][b]Terminal:[/b] Lose 1 max HP per new room; start combat with 5 Plating.
[/list]

[h2]Individual Ascension effects[/h2]
Choose any of the ten effects independently:
[list]
[*][b]Swarming Elites:[/b] More Elites.
[*][b]Weary Traveler:[/b] Ancients heal 80% of missing HP.
[*][b]Poverty:[/b] Enemies and chests drop 25% less Gold.
[*][b]Tight Belt:[/b] One fewer starting potion slot.
[*][b]Ascender's Bane:[/b] Start Cursed.
[*][b]Inflation:[/b] More expensive Merchant card removal.
[*][b]Scarcity:[/b] Rare and Upgraded cards appear less often.
[*][b]Tough Enemies:[/b] Enemies are harder to kill.
[*][b]Deadly Enemies:[/b] Deadlier enemy attacks.
[*][b]Double Boss:[/b] Two bosses at the end of Act 3.
[/list]
Enabling an effect sets Ascension to 0. Changing Ascension disables independent effects while preserving other modifiers.

[h2]How to use and compatibility[/h2]
Fully restart the game after updating. Enable Ultimate Custom Run in Settings > Mod Settings, start a Custom Run, select modifiers and values, then resolve starting effects at Neow.
Every co-op player needs the same mod version. Only the host edits sliders. Values persist in saves and presets and synchronize in co-op. Custom-only modifiers stay out of Daily Challenges; vanilla Daily values are preserved.
No BaseLib dependency or additional PCK. Use one installation; disable legacy SpecializedChoice. Built against Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0; pre-release version 1.7.0.

[h2]Report bugs and contribute[/h2]
[url=https://github.com/vertopolkaLF/ultimate-custom-run/issues/new/choose]Report a bug or suggest a feature[/url]

changeNote: Added 1-3 sliders for Rich Loot and Card Swarm (default 1). Limited ??? to 1-5 events (default 3), removed event repetition, and added an early exit when no eligible unvisited events remain. Fixed Proceed retry handling and matched native room fade-in behavior to avoid holding the action queue. Preserved legacy run history and completed-chain reloads.
